query_firewall.prior_p10_ids: Reconstruct exactly as sorted RandomState(991).choice(10000, 500, replace=False) and exclude.
query_firewall.new_evaluation_ids: From the remaining test IDs, draw 1000 without replacement using default_rng(2991), sort, and freeze before truth or search.
query_firewall.future_reserved: All other test IDs remain unaccessed.
query_firewall.content_overlap: Hash-audit selected query vectors against the first 1M base rows; require zero.

implementation.library: bundled hnswlib headers and repository Python hnswlib binding
implementation.distance_counter: Project-side native-compatible counting cosine space; per-query top-k must equal Python hnswlib on a pre-result smoke subset.

builds.target_unit: Each of all eight builds is a target cluster; the other seven are directed source builds.

source_target_estimand: For each directed source-target build pair and evaluation query, transport the source minimum safe registered ef to the target. Compare its failure event and target distance computations against the target-own minimum safe registered ef; retain right censoring.

reports: mean, p95, and p99 native distance computations
build time, truth time, search time, storage, and memory high-water

gates.instrumentation: Python-native and project-side counting runner top-k equality on at least 20 queries x 3 ef values before full replay.
gates.safety_phenomenon: Transport risk build-bootstrap lower bound > 0 and direction survives LOTO and delete-largest build.
gates.tail: Report p95/p99 without substituting batch-average latency.
gates.scope: Scale replication only; no TCP deployment or universal superiority claim.

stop_rules: Stop on dataset hash drift, query overlap, native-counter top-k mismatch, incomplete exact truth, or build replay failure.
Stop if data500 free space falls below projected additions plus 5 GiB.
Do not use prior P10 evaluation queries, validation-dev, formal-test, or any sealed role.
Do not change the grid, threshold, build seeds, orders, query IDs, or estimand after the first new search result.
